decisions.reason: The report requirement was fulfilled and verified by the indexing figures in the same message; the new instruction to re-index 164 links does not change the report's required content.
Submitting the 164 links for re-indexing does not resolve or change the separate question of whether links still unindexed after a couple of weeks will be replaced.
The re-indexing instruction concerns backlink remediation and does not alter the completed SEO plan's service areas or content constraints.
Re-indexing existing unindexed links does not change the campaign's specified backlink count or dofollow-to-nofollow ratio.
The backlink re-indexing instruction does not affect optimization of website meta titles or meta descriptions.
Backlink indexing remediation is distinct from the website sitemap already submitted and processed through Google Search Console.
The instruction to submit unindexed backlinks through an indexer does not change the required heading suggestions.
The backlink re-indexing instruction does not change the requirement to implement image ALT suggestions.
Submitting backlinks for re-indexing does not alter the approved webpage-content revisions.
The backlink remediation decision is unrelated to the Campus Launch sale page or its editing interface.
The re-indexing instruction does not change the separately requested before-and-after report for meta titles and descriptions.
Backlink re-indexing does not change the keyword count, search-volume requirement, or specified replacement keywords.
